description_en: Queries the list and details of shared cloud computers
description_zh: 查询共享型云电脑列表及详情
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-desktop-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-4676710000 --desktop-group-name CloudComputerPool01 --desktop-group-id dg-2i8qxpv6t1a030000 --period 1 --period-unit Month --max-results 10 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --policy-group-id pg-53iyi2aar0nd60000 --status 1 --own-type 0 --end-user-ids alice --excluded-end-user-ids Tony --protocol-type ASP --image-id m-eeuo9qab4b00000 --bundle-id b-4w5nk44znm60000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --multi-resource true --desktop-group-ids dg-2i8qxpv6t1a030000 --desktop-type eds.enterprise_office.16c64g --qos-rule-id qos-5605u0gelk2000000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDesktopGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office network to which the shared cloud computers belong
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑所属的办公网络ID
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the shared cloud computer to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的共享型云电脑名称，支持模糊查询
parameters.name: desktop_group_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑ID
parameters.name: desktop_group_id

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration of the shared cloud computer. The unit is specified by `PeriodUnit`
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月共享型云电脑的购买时长。单位由`PeriodUnit`指定。
如果`PeriodUnit`为`Month`，该参数的取值范围：
    - 1
    - 2
    - 3
    - 6
如果`PeriodUnit`为`Year`，该参数的取值范围：
    - 1
    - 2
    - 3
    - 4
    - 5
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the duration for the subscription billing method
parameters.help_zh: 包年包月计费方式的时长单位
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。
最大值：100。
默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next query. If NextToken is empty, no more results exist
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the policy associated with the shared cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑关联的策略ID
parameters.name: policy_group_id

parameters.help_en: The status of the shared cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑的状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The type of the shared cloud computer
parameters.help_zh:
共享型云电脑类型。

该参数暂未开放使用
parameters.name: own_type

parameters.help_en: The list of authorized user IDs for the shared cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑的授权用户ID列表
parameters.name: end_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of authorized users to exclude
parameters.help_zh: 要排除的已授权用户列表
parameters.name: excluded_end_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The protocol type
parameters.help_zh: 协议类型
parameters.name: protocol_type

parameters.help_en: The list of image IDs
parameters.help_zh: 镜像ID列表
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud computer template IDs
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑模板ID列表
parameters.name: bundle_id

fields.help_en: The tag key. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. You can specify 1 to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。可包含1\~20个
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the shared cloud computer is a multi-host type.

Valid values:
true: Multi-host shared cloud computer.
false: Single-host shared cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 是否为多台共享类型的共享型云电脑
parameters.name: multi_resource

parameters.help_en: The list of shared cloud computer IDs
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑ID列表
parameters.name: desktop_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer specifications. You can call [DescribeDesktopTypes](~~DescribeDesktopTypes~~) to query the supported specification IDs
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑规格。您可以调用[DescribeDesktopTypes](~~DescribeDesktopTypes~~)查询云电脑支持的规格ID
parameters.name: desktop_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the QoS rule
parameters.help_zh: 限速规则ID
parameters.name: qos_rule_id
